terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms apply when you order from {{name}} on this website, by WhatsApp or at the counter.
sections: Orders and prices
Prices are shown before you order and confirmed on the order page. Custom jobs are priced by the shop before you pay. Institution prices apply only to approved institution accounts.
Your files and designs
You confirm that you have the right to print everything you upload. We do not print material that is illegal, defamatory or infringes copyright or trademarks, and we may refuse such orders.
Proofs
For personalised items we send a proof. Please check names, spellings, photos and numbers carefully: once you approve a proof, we print exactly what you approved.
Payment
Online payments are processed by Razorpay. Orders paid online are started only after the payment is received. Unpaid online orders are cancelled automatically after the time shown at checkout.
Pickup and delivery
Pickup orders are handed over against the pickup code sent to you. Delivery orders are handed over against the delivery code; please share it only after you receive the order.
Liability
If we make a mistake, we reprint the affected items or refund their price. Our liability is limited to the value of the order.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We collect only what we need to make and deliver your order.
sections: What we collect
Your name, mobile number, email (institutions), delivery address, the files you upload and your order history.
How we use it
To price, print and deliver your orders, send order updates by email or SMS, issue invoices and answer your questions. We do not sell your data.
Identity documents
Aadhaar, PAN and other ID documents are stored privately, visible only to shop staff through short-lived links, and deleted automatically after the retention period once the order is completed.
Student and staff data

Schools and colleges can keep a list of their students and staff with us (names, class, parents' names, date of birth, contact details and photos) for printing ID cards and similar items. The institution decides what goes on the list and can edit, download or delete it at any time. Only that institution and our shop staff can see it, photos are stored privately, and a person's photo is deleted when they are removed from the list. We never use this data for marketing or share it with anyone else.
Service providers
We use Amazon Web Services (file storage), Razorpay (payments), Google Gmail (order and sign-in emails) and MSG91 (text messages, when switched on). They process data only to provide these services.
Website visits

We count visits to this website to see which pages help customers. This uses no cookies and no advertising or tracking services: our own server keeps only daily totals (pages viewed, the kind of device, and whether you came from a search engine or social media). Your IP address is never stored. If your browser sends “Do Not Track” or “Global Privacy Control”, you are not counted.
Complaints

If something went wrong with your order or your data, contact the shop first. If it is not resolved, write to the grievance officer named at the bottom of every page; we acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and aim to resolve them within one month.
Your choices
You can ask us to correct or delete your account and data by contacting the shop. Invoices are kept as required by tax law.

refund.title: Refund and cancellation policy
refund.intro: Printed and personalised items are made to order, so cancellations depend on how far the work has gone.
sections: Cancelling
You can cancel online from My orders until work starts (while the order is received or waiting for payment or price). After that, please call the shop.
Refunds for online payments
If you cancel a paid order before work starts, the full amount is refunded automatically to the original payment method. Refunds reach your account in 5–7 working days.
Counter payments
Money paid at the counter is refunded at the counter.
Printing mistakes
If an item is damaged or differs from the approved proof because of our mistake, tell us within 3 days of pickup or delivery. We will reprint it or refund its price.
Not refundable
Items printed exactly as you approved them, mistakes in files or details you provided, and custom jobs already in production.

shipping.title: Shipping and delivery policy
shipping.intro: We deliver locally from our shop. Pickup from the shop is always available.
sections: Where we deliver
Home delivery is offered in our local area when it is switched on at checkout. The delivery fee is shown before you order; delivery is free above the amount shown.
When
Most print orders are ready the same or next working day; personalised and bulk orders take longer and the order page shows their progress. We message you when your order is out for delivery.
Handover
The delivery person asks for the 4-digit delivery code sent to you. Cash on delivery is collected at the door when the order is not prepaid.
Missed deliveries
If nobody is available, we try again and let you know. After repeated failed attempts we will call you to arrange delivery or pickup.
